title: 第9章 接手百草轩第10章 九玄丹经

此时，周尘已带着林清萱走出林家大门。
还没多远，林清萱便停下脚步，一把拉住周尘的手腕，急忙问道：
“小尘，你到底是怎么从玉女宫那种地方安全回来的？”
“我听说那宫主吕玉清是吃人不吐骨头的妖女。修炼的更是采补男人元阳的邪功！入赘的男子，从来没有活着出来的！你…”
“你快让我看看！你的身体……你的元阳……到底有没有被……”
话未说完，她已是俏脸绯红，后面“被吸干”几个字终究是女儿家羞涩，无法大方说出来。
周尘猝不及防被义姐这般近距离接触，顿时闻到一股幽兰般的清香扑面而来。
林清萱的俏脸近在咫尺，白皙的肌肤在夕阳下泛着淡淡的光晕。
他这才发现，自己这位义姐竟是如此清丽绝俗。
一袭素白长裙衬得她宛如出水芙蓉，眉目如画，气质出尘，论姿色确实冠绝天风城。
周尘尴尬道：“清宣姐，你放心，我好得很。等回去后我再跟你细说。”
林清萱这才意识到两人的姿势太过暧昧，连忙松开手，后退半步。
她俏脸微红，轻咳一声掩饰尴尬：“你...你没事就好。”
“我们...我们快回百草轩吧。”
两人很快回到了略显冷清的百草轩，林清萱迫不及待地再次追问。
周尘斟酌开口，解释道：“清萱姐，其实…我觉醒了一种特殊体质，名为纯阳道体。”
他隐去了阴阳塔和羲和女帝的存在，只挑能说的部分。
“那玉女宫主吕玉清想采补我，却反被我这体质克制，无法得逞。她奈何不了我，又怕我反噬她，最后只能放我离开。”
他略去了双修反噬，更不好意思提自己反采补了吕玉清一事。

并非不信任义姐，只是那些事，实在不好细说。
林清萱听得美眸圆睁，小嘴微张：“纯阳道体？竟如此厉害？能克制那妖女的采补邪功？”
她虽从未听闻此体质，但见周尘安然无恙，气息似乎比之前更盛，心中信了大半。
她长长舒了口气，眼中泛起水光：“不管怎样，你能平安回来就好…真是上天保佑…”
就在这时，一个百草轩的帮工，急匆匆地从后堂跑了出来：
“不好了！”
“刚才林家药园的人过来传话了，说…说奉家主之命，从今日起，林家所有的药园和渠道，一律不再供应给我们百草轩任何药材！以前订好的货也全部扣下了！”
他顿了顿，脸色更加难看：“还有…还有黑虎帮三个月前预订的那批‘金疮散’和‘大力丸’，约定的交付期限就在半个月后！”
“黑虎帮的副帮主刚才派人来放话了，说这是他们帮派急需的物资，要是到期交不出货，不仅定金不退，还要砸了我们百草轩的招牌，让咱们在天风城混不下去！”
“黑虎帮那群人凶神恶煞，说得出做得到啊！”
周尘眉头微微一皱：“黑虎帮？”
如果他记得没错的话，这黑虎帮乃是天风城中一个帮派势力，帮中成员众多，实力颇强。
林清萱闻言，刚刚放下的心瞬间又提了起来，皱眉解释道：

At this time, Zhou Chen had taken Lin Qingxuan out of the Lin family gate.
Before long, Lin Qingxuan stopped, grabbed Zhou Chen's wrist, and asked hurriedly:
"Xiaochen, how on earth did you come back safely from a place like the Jade Girl Palace?"
"I heard that the palace master Lu Yuqing is a witch who eats people without spitting out their bones. She practices evil skills that replenish men's yang! No man who gets married has ever come out alive! You..."
"Hurry up and let me see! Your body...your Yuan Yang...has been..."
Before she finished speaking, her pretty face was already blushing. The words "sucked dry" behind them were because her daughter was too shy to say them openly.
Zhou Chen was caught off guard by such a close contact with his sworn sister, and he immediately smelled an orchid-like fragrance hitting his face.
Lin Qingxuan's pretty face was very close, her fair skin glowing faintly in the sunset.
Only then did he realize that his adopted sister was so beautiful and elegant.
Wearing a plain white dress, she looked like a hibiscus emerging from the water. Her eyebrows were picturesque and her temperament was extraordinary. In terms of beauty, she was indeed the best in Tianfeng City.
Zhou Chen said awkwardly: "Sister Qingxuan, don't worry, I'm very fine. I'll tell you in detail when I get back."
Only then did Lin Qingxuan realize that their posture was too ambiguous, so she quickly let go of her hands and took half a step back.
Her pretty face turned red, and she coughed slightly to cover up her embarrassment: "You... Just be fine."
"Let's... let's go back to Baicao Pavilion quickly."
The two quickly returned to the slightly deserted Baicao Pavilion, and Lin Qingxuan couldn't wait to ask again.
Zhou Chen spoke carefully and explained: "Sister Qingxuan, actually... I have awakened a special physique called Chunyang Dao Body."
He concealed the existence of the Yin-Yang Tower and Empress Xi and only picked out the parts that could be said.
"The Jade Lady Palace Master Lu Yuqing wanted to pluck me, but was restrained by my physique and couldn't succeed. She couldn't do anything to me, and she was afraid that I would backfire on her, so she had no choice but to let me go."
He omitted the backlash of dual cultivation, and was even more embarrassed to mention that he had counterattacked Lu Yuqing.
It's not that I don't trust my sworn sister, it's just that it's hard to go into detail about those things.
Lin Qingxuan's beautiful eyes widened when she heard this, and her little mouth opened slightly: "Pure Yang Dao body? So powerful? Can you restrain the evil girl's evil harvesting power?"
Although she had never heard of this constitution, she was convinced when she saw that Zhou Chen was safe and sound and his aura seemed to be stronger than before.
She breathed a long sigh of relief, her eyes filled with water: "No matter what, it's great that you can come back safely... It's really a blessing from God..."
At this moment, a helper from Baicaoxuan hurriedly ran out from the back hall:
"It's not good!"
"The people from the Lin Family Medicine Garden came here just now to send a message, saying that... on the orders of the family leader, from today on, all Lin Family Medicine Gardens and channels will no longer supply any medicinal materials to our Baicao Xuan! All previously ordered goods have also been withheld!"
He paused and his face became even more ugly: "And...there are also the batch of 'Jin Zhang Powder' and 'Dali Pills' that the Black Tiger Gang ordered three months ago. The agreed delivery deadline is half a month later!"
"The deputy gang leader of the Black Tiger Gang just sent someone to tell us that these are urgently needed supplies for their gang. If they are not delivered by the due date, not only will the deposit not be refunded, but our Baicao Xuan signboard will also be destroyed, making it impossible for us to survive in Tianfeng City!"
"Those people from the Black Tiger Gang are so vicious, you can tell what they are doing!"
Zhou Chen frowned slightly: "Black Tiger Gang?"
If he remembered correctly, the Black Tiger Gang was a gang in Tianfeng City with many members and strong strength.
When Lin Qingxuan heard this, her heart that had just been put down suddenly rose again, she frowned and explained:
